title: PM–Eng 1:1 prep — API / Console / Dedicated / Private
content:
Agenda (30m)
- Quick sync (5m): how week is going, skirts and fires
- API product questions (10m): rate limits, streaming SLA changes, known regressions
- Console rollout plan (7m): telemetry gating + canary plan for 2.1 UI changes
- Dedicated/Private customer asks (5m): capacity leads, on-prem packaging timeline
- Action items + blockers (3m)

Notes / Context
- Priya returning from PTO; high-level ask: validate we can push console canary next week if latency looks stable. She mentioned concerns about the new streaming chunking change increasing cold-start 95p latency by ~30ms on p4d. Need quick A/B with older path.
- Customer: AcmeCorp (Dedicated) asked about private deployment checklist + HSM integration timeline — they want a tentative delivery window by EOW. Sales asked for a short FAQ.
- Private: compliance review flagged audit log retention for on-prem (need clear config + docs).

Open items I want to cover with Priya
- Streaming chunking: is the regression real or measurement artifact? (INF-391 attached). Who owns the perf test to reproduce with 8k context?
- Canary gating: what telemetry threshold should block a rollout? Proposed: 95p token latency + error rate spike > 0.5% for 30m. Ask Priya if that aligns with SRE tolerances.
- Dedicated autoscaling: current reserve sizing logic underestimates tail spikes for multimodal customers — ask for timeline on burst-capacity refactor.
- Private on-prem package: is the packaging work on-track for M22? What are blockers (legal, packaging team, infra)?

Draft talking points / phrasing
- "We saw a 30ms 95p delta in streaming after chunking change — do we think it's risky for canary? If it's noise we can proceed with tighter telemetry; if not, pause and roll back chunking for canary path."
- "For AcmeCorp: can we commit to a delivery window? If not, let's give a 'target month' and offer a compliance checklist so they feel progress."

Proposed decisions to land in meeting
- Decision A: If streaming 95p delta <= 35ms and no >0.5% error spike, proceed with canary next Tues. Else hold and investigate.
- Decision B: Provide AcmeCorp a one-page private-deploy checklist + target shipping month (not firm) by EOW.
- Decision C: Add a spike-protection flag to Dedicated autoscaler backlog and prioritize in the next sprint if PRD approved.

Action items (assign tentative owners)
- Priya: run an 8k-context perf job reproducer for streaming chunking (INF-391) — due Thu 2026-02-25.
- Ryan (me): draft AcmeCorp private-deploy FAQ + checklist; loop in Legal + Solutions Eng — due Fri 2026-02-27.
- Alicia: prepare telemetry dashboard draft for canary gating with thresholds and alerting playbook — due Mon 2026-03-01.
- Eng (platform): triage Dedicated autoscaler backlog item and scope spike-protection flag — owner TBD, propose by next sprint planning.

Risks / notes to surface
- If we proceed with canary w/out a rollback path for the chunking change, we risk customer-facing latency regressions. Make sure we have auto-fallback configured.
- On-prem audit log retention: if we can't provide config short-term, Sales may push timeline or require compensation. Highlight to Priya and Legal.

Follow-up items post-meeting (how I'll capture)
- Update PROD-482 with agreed canary gating thresholds and link the perf job results.
- Share AcmeCorp checklist as a Google Drive doc and ping AE + Solutions Eng.
- Add Dedicated autoscaler spike-protection ticket to sprint board and tag SRE.

Quick personal notes (scratch)
- Bring up cross-team bandwidth — Priya's team is stretched with release + infra. Might need to pull in 1 IC from infra to help validate streaming perf.
- Keep tone collaborative: frame canary decision as "data-driven" not blame.

Conversation prompts (if it stalls)
- "What's the minimum telemetry you'd feel comfortable with to start a canary?"
- "If we had to pause the chunking change, what's the rollback time and user impact?"

Draft email to send after meeting (short)
- Subject: Follow-up: 1:1 decisions — canary gating, AcmeCorp checklist, autoscaler backlog
- Body (bullets): Decisions, owners, due dates, links to artifacts. Ask to confirm owners and escalate if any due dates are unrealistic.

-- end of notes
